input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user, person, company. The platform provides capabilities for notification. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include search functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage person records, so that I can track and organize person data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage company records, so that I can track and organize company data effectively.
As a User, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
